name: צָדוֹק
summary: Chiefly the priest of David and Solomon, son of Ahitub, of the line of Eleazar son of Aaron (1Ch 5:34). He stayed faithful in Absalom's revolt and in Adonijah's, anointed Solomon king at Gihon, and was put by Solomon in the place of Abiathar, whose removal fulfilled the word spoken against Eli's house (1Ki 1:8, 39; 2:27, 35). In Ezekiel's temple only “the sons of Zadok”, who kept the charge of the sanctuary when Israel went astray, come near to Yahweh to minister (Ezk 44:15; 48:11). Others bearing the name: the grandfather of Jotham through his mother Jerusha (2Ki 15:33), men of Nehemiah's day, and an ancestor of Jesus in Matthew's genealogy (Mat 1:14). The name is formed like the adjective צַדִּיק, “righteous”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “וְצָדוֹק בֶּן אֲחִיטוּב and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests.”
“Ahitub fathered צָדוֹק, and צָדוֹק fathered Ahimaaz”, in the line of Aaron's son Eleazar.
Zadok and the Levites carry the ark of the covenant of God as David flees Absalom.
Zadok the priest was not with Adonijah.
“צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon.”
Solomon thrust out Abiathar, “to fulfil the word of Yahweh which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh”.
“Zadok the priest the king put in the place of Abiathar.”
The word against Eli's house: “I will raise up for myself a faithful priest (כֹּהֵן נֶאֱמָן).”
They anointed Solomon to Yahweh as leader, “and Zadok as priest”.
“The priests the Levites, בְּנֵי צָדוֹק, who kept the charge of my sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me.”
Zadok son of Baana repairs the wall.
Zadok the scribe, a treasurer counted faithful.
“Azor fathered Σαδώκ, and Σαδὼκ fathered Achim.”

note: The form צָדוֹק (qatōl) is an adjective form, “righteous”; no verse explains the name, so the gloss rests on the form and the root. TIPNR's Zadok@1Ch.6.12 uses the English verse numbering (Hebrew 1Ch 5:38). The tie of 1Sa 2:35 (“a faithful priest”) to Zadok is drawn from 1Ki 2:27, 35, which fulfil the word on Eli's house by putting Zadok in Abiathar's place; the verse itself names no one.
